_about: Editorial topics for the Root Rules Encyclopedia, keyed by rule and section ids from data/root/law-2025-10-13. Not official rule content. A topic gathers rules in three ways: whole sections (sections), single rules with a stated reason (rules), and rules whose printed title contains one of title_terms (matched as whole words at a word start). section_titles does the same for section headings (e.g. every faction's 'Faction Setup'). status is 'draft' until the project owner has reviewed the topic; see review for the last owner review.

review.method: Review page built by scripts/root/make_topic_review.ts: one card per topic and faction extra, listing every section, pick (with reason) and title match, plus one card on how faction pages choose general rules.
review.result: 20 of 20 cards approved (17 topics, 2 faction extras, and the general-rules method); no problems or notes.

topics.name: Battle
topics.description: Ambushes, dice, hits and removing pieces, plus each faction's battle actions.

rules.reason: Ambush cards are played in battle (4.3.1).
Who makes the decisions in a forced battle.
Points for removing enemy buildings and tokens, which battle hits do.
Changes which side deals the higher roll when the Alliance defends.
Applies when Cult warriors are removed while defending in battle.
Crusade initiates a battle (optionally after a move).
An extra hit for the Corvids when defending.
Adds defending warriors when the Diaspora defends at an enclave.
Retaliate: the Diaspora must battle at each Militant enclave.
Council warriors join the defence at assemblies.

topics.name: Movement
topics.description: Moving warriors and pawns between clearings, and each faction's move actions.

rules.reason: Moves go to an adjacent clearing (4.2).
Rivers are not paths unless a rule says so.
Crusade can move from an Outcast clearing.
Nimble: the Corvids move regardless of who rules.
Swimmers: the Diaspora move along rivers, ignoring rule.
Settle moves into the chosen clearing.

topics.name: Crafting
topics.description: Crafting cards with crafting pieces, immediate and persistent effects, and each faction's crafting rules.

rules.reason: Crafted persistent effects go in your play area.

topics.name: Items
topics.description: The item supply, gaining items by crafting, and the rules for factions that use items.

rules.reason: Crafting a card that shows an item takes it from the supply.

topics.name: Ruling clearings
topics.description: Who rules a clearing, and the rules that depend on ruling.

rules.reason: Moving requires ruling the origin or destination.
Suit dominance is won by ruling clearings.
Bird dominance is won by ruling corner clearings.
Treating enemy pieces as your own for rule.
Nimble lets the Corvids move without ruling either clearing.
Swimmers lets the Diaspora move along rivers ignoring rule.

topics.name: Recruiting
topics.description: Each faction's recruit actions and abilities. The Law has no general recruiting rule; recruiting is defined faction by faction.
